RCIP- List of Designated Employers

The following employers are designated under the Brandon RCIP. Designated employers can use the program to hire foreign workers or support employees on temporary status in gaining permanent residency. For more details on becoming a designated employer, see the RCIP Employer Checklist.

 Note to Foreign Skilled Workers:

  1. This list will be updated regularly as additional employers are designated. If you are currently employed in Brandon, you may request your employer to apply for designation. However, it is at the discretion of your employer; they are not obligated to apply for designation if they choose not to participate in the program.
  2. Not all employers listed here may be hiring at the present time; employers might apply for designation solely to support existing employees in obtaining permanent residency.
  3. If you are not qualified for the position listed, do not apply. You will be wasting employers' resources and your time. 
  4. Only positions within the Brandon RCIP Program Boundaries are eligible. Obtaining a job offer from a Designated Employer for a position outside of the Program Boundaries would not allow you to apply under RCIP.
  5. Please note that designated employers are not obligated to endorse all or any current employee to RCIP. Designated employers might have internal processes to decide on who to put through RCIP.

Designated Employers

Notes

Prairie Mountain Health (PMH)
  • ONLY POSITIONS WITHIN THE BRANDON RCIP PROGRAM BOUNDARIES ARE ELIGIBLE. 
    • Although PMH is a Designated Employer, there is only one approved location: Brandon, Manitoba. While PMH operates throughout the prairie region, only positions in Brandon qualify for RCIP.
  • If you are not licensed to practice in Canada, do not apply for positions with PMH.
    • PMH is utilizing RCIP to support existing employees or candidates who are already licensed to practice in Canada.
  • PMH often uses the following naming
    • The title “Nurse II” at PMH corresponds to the occupation Registered Nurse (NOC 31301).
    • The title “Health Care Aide” refers to NOC 33102. 
  • PMH uses the Equivalent Full Time (EFT) scheduling system. To qualify for RCIP, a position must offer a minimum guaranteed work hours of 30 hours per week or more.

City of Brandon

The City of Brandon has been designated as an employer under the Rural Community Immigration Pilot (RCIP) to support the recruitment of specialized and hard‑to‑fill positions that cannot be readily filled through the local labour market.


It is important to note that RCIP is not a general hiring pathway and does not apply to all employment opportunities within the City. Only positions that meet specific program criteria, including demonstrated labour shortages and alignment with priority occupations, may be considered eligible. The City remains committed to prioritizing local recruitment efforts and ensuring that employment opportunities are first accessible to qualified candidates within the community.

As the administrator of RCIP locally, Economic Development Brandon applies the same objective assessment criteria to all employers, including the City itself. Candidates applying to positions with the City of Brandon do not receive preferential treatment under the program.

Western Medical Clinic

Western Medical Clinic is seeking to hire Family Physicians (31102 - General practitioners and family physicians ) on a fee-for-service basis We are looking for physicians trained in Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, or Australia who are ready to transition into an established practice with existing patient panels and immediate access to a well-supported clinic environment, where patients are already receiving high-quality care.

At Western Medical Clinic, you will find more than just a place to practice medicine. You will become part of a collaborative team committed to providing compassionate, high-quality patient care while enjoying the professional fulfillment and work-life balance that come with living and working in a vibrant regional community.

Our modern, professionally designed clinic is conveniently located, has READY MADE PATIENT PANELS AVAILABLE and offers an ideal environment to further establish and grow your practice. Physicians benefit from fully equipped turnkey office space, a collegial network of family physicians and specialists, and exceptional clinical and administrative support. Services include in-house physician billing support and an onsite pharmacy, allowing you to focus on patient care while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

If you are ready to build your future in Canada, we would love to hear from you. Please contact Sandra at This email address is being protected from spambots. You need JavaScript enabled to view it..

Successful candidates will receive complimentary support from the clinic's immigration consultant throughout the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Manitoba (CPSM) licensing process, work permit application, and permanent residence journey. While processing times cannot be guaranteed, physicians may be eligible to receive a work permit in as little as two weeks, and permanent residence applications may be finalized in approximately 5 to 6 months, depending on individual circumstances and government processing times.
